name: mirage
text: Not fully. The engine's Novig socket is connected (live feed, compressed) and the read key runs at 16 reads a second. But the scan still reads each Novig market's book by request: about 10,000 markets at 16 a second is roughly 10 minutes for a cold pass, and it's at 3,213 of 10,099 right now. The socket is used for the soonest games and for checking best bids, not to hold all 10,000 markets. So it is not yet 'constantly updated'. What I can do: subscribe the soonest ~12 hours of markets on the socket and read only the rest by request. Then those lines stay live and the long pass only covers far-off games. That is TASKS.md TCL16's open option, and I'll start on it after v1.0.44 lands.
